requirements.anchor: Build a tiny dependency-free Node.js slugifier with automated tests and usage documentation.
requirements.title: Deliver documented, tested dependency-free slugifier
criteria: slugify.mjs exports slugify(value), validates string input with TypeError, applies NFKD and combining-mark removal, lowercase ASCII-alphanumeric hyphen collapse and trimming, and returns empty for empty/punctuation-only input.

cli.mjs imports slugify, joins command-line arguments with spaces, emits exactly one newline-terminated slug on success, and emits a short stderr usage message with exit status 1 when given no arguments.
slugify.test.mjs uses node:test and assert to cover all specified function and CLI cases, including spawned CLI success and no-argument failure.
README.md documents API, provided examples, CLI use, and npm test.
Only the four requested new deliverable files are added; package.json and ROADMAP.md remain supplied files.

evidence.description: Inspected slugify.mjs implementation on final manifest; its NFKD, Unicode combining-mark, ASCII separator-collapse, trim, and TypeError behavior are additionally covered by the passing test command.

Inspected Node built-in test/assert suite covering all required cases; npm test passed 6/6.
Inspected README API, examples, CLI, and npm test documentation.
Final manifest has precisely the supplied package.json and ROADMAP.md plus the four requested deliverable files.
